key.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused.
key.description: The new role's key, unique in the organization. Documents and assignments name the role by it.

name.description: The display name, 1 to 60 characters; surrounding spaces are removed.

inherits.description: Keys of the roles to inherit from. A key that names no role is accepted and warns. Left out, the role inherits from nobody; a key that would lead back to this role is refused with `role_cycle`.
